description: This file contains a PHP trait 'StreamDecoratorTrait' used in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation. It provides a decorator pattern around a StreamInterface object, adding methods for stream management such as __toString, getContents, seek, read, write, and magic methods for dynamic stream creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the trait with a StreamInterface object to decorate.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to lazily create or access the 'stream' property.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the stream as a string, seeking to position 0 if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string using Utils::copyToString.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the decorated stream and returns either the result or $this.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information from the underlying stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset in the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to implement stream creation logic.
